title: eval-unlearn: Benchmarking unlearning in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
title_zh: eval-unlearn: 一个概念去学习基准测试框架

paragraphs.en: The rising number of concept unlearning techniques for text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models has produced a fragmented evaluation landscape. Methods are assessed under heterogeneous experimental conditions making principled cross-method comparison difficult. We present eval-unlearn , an open-source Python library providing a unified, reproducible benchmarking framework for concept unlearning in T2I Diffusion models. eval-unlearn integrates twelve published unlearning techniques spanning fine-tuning, closed-form model editing, and inference-time intervention, alongside nine complementary evaluation metrics covering erasure efficacy, adversarial robustness, generative quality, and concept retention. Its plugin architecture lets third-party techniques and metrics self-register without modifying the core framework, and its streaming, batched pipeline supports efficient evaluation of both standard NSFW concepts and arbitrary general concepts. As a further contribution, we release a public leaderboard on HuggingFace along with an interactive tool for real-time evaluation of unlearning techniques. The leaderboard compares nudity concept erasure case study across all twelve techniques, exposing significant accuracy-quality trade-offs that are obscured by heterogeneous evaluation. eval-unlearn is released under the MIT license; the package, code, leaderboard, and documentation are all available at https://eval-unlearn.readthedocs.io .
paragraphs.zh: 文本到图像（T2I）扩散模型中概念遗忘技术的数量不断上升，导致评估领域变得支离破碎。 这些方法在异构的实验条件下进行评估，使得基于原则的方法间比较变得困难。 我们提出了 eval-unlearn，一个开源的 Python 库，为 T2I 扩散模型中的概念遗忘提供统一且可复现的基准测试框架。eval-unlearn 整合了十二种已发表的遗忘技术，涵盖微调、闭式模型编辑和推理时干预，并附带九种互补的评估指标，覆盖消除效果、对抗性鲁棒性、生成质量和概念保留能力。 其插件架构允许第三方技术和指标无需修改核心框架即可自行注册，而流式和批处理管道则支持对标准 NSFW 概念和任意通用概念的高效评估。 作为进一步的贡献，我们在 HuggingFace 上发布了一个公共排行榜，并附上了用于实时评估遗忘技术的交互式工具。 该排行榜通过所有十二种技术对比了裸体概念的消除案例研究，揭示了异构评估所掩盖的显著准确性与质量之间的权衡。eval-unlearn 采用 MIT 许可证发布；其包、代码、排行榜和文档均可在 https://eval-unlearn.readthedocs.io 获取。

paragraphs.en: {m.-24, nikhil.raghavan, zixia.huang, kai-sheng.ong, dylan.lim, brandon.ling, f.leofante}@imperial.ac.uk

paragraphs.en: Text-to-image diffusion models such as Stable Diffusion ( Rombach et al. 2022 ) synthesize high-quality images from natural language prompts, but training on large, internet-scraped corpora makes them capable of generating inappropriate content, with many negative implications ( Schramowski et al. 2023 ) . Fully retraining on curated data is both expensive and often ineffective due to compositionality ( Okawa et al. 2023 ) . Machine unlearning offers a practical alternative, using targeted weight modifications or inference-time interventions to selectively suppress a concept from a trained model ( Beerens et al. 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 像 Stable Diffusion（Rombach 等人，2022）这样的文本到图像扩散模型能够根据自然语言提示生成高质量图像，但由于在从互联网抓取的大型语料库上进行训练，它们也可能生成不当内容，并带来许多负面影响（Schramowski 等人，2023）。 由于组合性（Okawa 等人，2023），在精选数据上完全重新训练既昂贵又常常无效。 机器遗忘提供了一种实用的替代方案，它通过有针对性的权重修改或推理时的干预，选择性地从已训练的模型中抑制某个概念（Beerens 等人，2025）。

sents.en: Machine unlearning offers a practical alternative, using targeted weight modifications or inference-time interventions to selectively suppress a concept from a trained model ( Beerens et al. 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 机器遗忘提供了一种实用的替代方案，它通过有针对性的权重修改或推理时的干预，选择性地从已训练的模型中抑制某个概念（Beerens 等人，2025）。

paragraphs.en: A recent survey ( Kim and Qi 2025 ) groups T2I unlearning techniques into three categories: fine-tuning methods (ESD ( Gandikota et al. 2023 ) , CA ( Kumari et al. 2023 ) , CoGFD ( hongyi nie et al. 2025 ) , AdvUnlearn ( Zhang et al. 2024b ) , SSD ( Foster et al. 2023 ) ) that iteratively adjust U-Net or text-encoder weights; closed-form model editing methods (UCE ( Gandikota et al. 2024 ) , MACE ( Lu et al. 2024 ) ) that compute single-step weight updates without iterative optimisation; and inference-time interventions (SLD ( Schramowski et al. 2023 ) , SAFREE ( Yoon et al. 2025 ) , TraSCE ( Jain et al. 2025 ) , ConceptSteerers ( Kim and Ghadiyaram 2025 ) , SAeUron ( Cywiński and Deja 2025 ) ) that reshape guidance or latent representations at inference time without modifying weights.
paragraphs.zh: 最近的一项研究（Kim 和 Qi，2025）将 T2I 遗忘技术分为三类：微调方法（ESD（Gandikota 等人，2023）、CA（Kumari 等人，2023）、CoGFD（hongyi nie 等人，2025）、AdvUnlearn（Zhang 等人，2024b）、SSD（Foster 等人，2023）），这些方法通过迭代调整 U-Net 或文本编码器的权重来实现遗忘；闭式模型编辑方法（UCE（Gandikota 等人，2024）、MACE（Lu 等人，2024）），这些方法无需迭代优化即可计算单步权重更新；以及推理时干预方法（SLD（Schramowski 等人，2023）、SAFREE（Yoon 等人，2025）、TraSCE（Jain 等人，2025）、ConceptSteerers（Kim 和 Ghadiyaram，2025）、SAeUron（Cywiński 和 Deja，2025）），这些方法在推理时重塑引导或潜在表示，而无需修改模型权重。

paragraphs.en: Despite this taxonomy, techniques are evaluated on different datasets, metrics, and hyperparameter regimes, making reliable cross-method comparison difficult. Existing frameworks, namely UnlearnCanvas ( Zhang et al. 2024a ) and the Holistic Unlearning Benchmark ( Moon et al. 2025 ) , provide fixed dataset-and-script packages covering a narrow, largely fine-tuning/closed-form set of techniques, with no interface for extension without modifying core code. eval-unlearn closes these gaps with a plugin architecture spanning all three categories. Its contributions are: (i) a shared execution pipeline supporting all three technique categories on a common base model; (ii) nine standardized metrics spanning erasure efficacy, adversarial robustness, quality, and retention; (iii) a plugin architecture, with a validation notebook for community-contributed techniques and metrics, enabling extension without modifying the core framework; and (iv) a public HuggingFace leaderboard, logged with full hyperparameters for reproducibility, enabling real-time comparison of unlearning techniques. The library is further accompanied by tutorial notebooks and a test suite exercised in continuous integration, currently at 99.82% coverage. Figure 1 illustrates the resulting pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管存在这种分类体系，但各项技术是在不同的数据集、评估指标和超参数配置下进行评估的，这使得不同方法之间的可靠比较变得困难。 现有的框架，即 UnlearnCanvas（Zhang 等人，2024a）和 Holistic Unlearning Benchmark（Moon 等人，2025），仅提供固定的数据集与脚本包，涵盖范围狭窄、主要局限于微调或闭式解的技术，且无法在不修改核心代码的情况下扩展。eval-unlearn 通过一种覆盖全部三类技术的插件架构填补了这些空白。 其主要贡献包括：(i) 一个共享的执行流程，支持在通用基础模型上运行所有三类技术；(ii) 九项标准化指标，涵盖擦除效果、对抗性鲁棒性、质量与知识保留能力；(iii) 一种插件架构，并附带用于验证社区贡献技术与指标的笔记本，从而实现无需修改核心框架即可扩展；以及 (iv) 一个公开的 HuggingFace 排行榜，记录完整的超参数以确保可重复性，支持对去学习技术进行实时比较。 该库还附带了教程笔记本和测试套件，后者已在持续集成中运行，当前代码覆盖率为 99.82%。 图 1 展示了由此构建的执行流程。

paragraphs.en: eval-unlearn v1.1.2 integrates twelve techniques spanning the three categories introduced in Section 1 (fine-tuning, closed-form editing, inference-time intervention), all targeting Stable Diffusion v1.4 as the base model, with the exception of SLD, which couples to its safety-fine-tuned variant. The framework additionally allows any custom checkpoint or HuggingFace model ID to be evaluated without writing wrapper code, and technique packages are separately installable so users need only the components required for their experiment.
paragraphs.zh: eval-unlearn v1.1.2 整合了涵盖第 1 节所介绍的三类方法（微调、闭式编辑、推理时干预）的十二种技术，所有这些技术都以 Stable Diffusion v1.4 为基础模型，唯一例外是 SLD，它与经过安全微调的变体相耦合。 该框架还允许无需编写包装代码即可评估任何自定义检查点或 HuggingFace 模型 ID，并且技术包可以单独安装，因此用户只需使用实验中所需的组件即可。

sents.zh: 该框架还允许无需编写包装代码即可评估任何自定义检查点或 HuggingFace 模型 ID，并且技术包可以单独安装，因此用户只需使用实验中所需的组件即可。

paragraphs.en: Alongside these, the library provides nine evaluation metrics spanning four categories. Erasure efficacy is measured via attack success rate (ASR) on the I2P benchmark ( Schramowski et al. 2023 ) . Adversarial robustness is measured via ASR under three optimisation-based red-teaming attacks: Ring-A-Bell’s genetic search ( Tsai et al. 2024 ) , MMA-Diffusion’s GCG suffix attack ( Yang and others 2023 ) , and P4D’s gradient-based prompt optimisation ( Chin et al. 2024 ) . Generative quality is captured by FID and CLIP Score against COCO 2017 ( Lin et al. 2014 ) , and by TIFA for compositional fidelity ( Hu et al. 2023 ) . Concept retention is assessed via the ERR erasure-retention metric ( Liu et al. 2025 ) and UA-IRA, a retention score computed over user-provided prompts.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，该库还提供了涵盖四个类别的九项评估指标。 擦除有效性通过 I2P 基准测试中的攻击成功率（ASR）进行衡量（Schramowski 等人，2023）。 对抗性鲁棒性通过三种基于优化的红队攻击中的 ASR 进行衡量：Ring-A-Bell 的遗传搜索（Tsai 等人，2024）、MMA-Diffusion 的 GCG 后缀攻击（Yang 等，2023）以及 P4D 的基于梯度的提示优化（Chin 等人，2024）。 生成质量通过针对 COCO 2017 数据集的 FID 和 CLIP Score 进行评估（Lin 等人，2014），并通过 TIFA 评估其组合保真度（Hu 等人，2023）。 概念保留性通过 ERR 擦除-保留指标（Liu 等人，2025）以及 UA-IRA 进行评估，后者是一个基于用户提供的提示计算出的保留分数。

paragraphs.en: The configuration for both the unlearning method and the metric computation is exposed through the technique_config and metric_configs variables of SingleBenchmarkRunner and MultiBenchmarkRunner , respectively. Default values follow either accepted standardised conventions or the values reported in each metric’s or technique’s original publication, as documented in the library documentation.
paragraphs.zh: 无论是遗忘方法还是指标计算的配置，都分别通过 SingleBenchmarkRunner 和 MultiBenchmarkRunner 的 technique_config 和 metric_configs 变量进行设置。 默认值遵循公认的标准规范，或采用各指标或技术原始出版物中报告的值，具体如库文档所述。

paragraphs.en: eval-unlearn is organised around a small set of core components following the Adapter design pattern ( McDonough 2017 ) : the framework defines fixed abstract interfaces, while external implementations are integrated through wrapper classes, keeping orchestration logic agnostic to technique and metric internals. Technique versions are pinned to their most recent release (Sept 2026) for reproducibility.
paragraphs.zh: eval-unlearn 围绕一组核心组件构建，遵循适配器设计模式（McDonough 2017）：该框架定义了固定的抽象接口，而外部实现则通过包装类进行集成，从而使得协调逻辑与具体技术或指标的内部细节无关。 为确保可重复性，各技术的版本被锁定在其最新发布的版本（2026年9月）。

paragraphs.en: Technique. A technique is a concept-erasure method exposed through a wrapper implementing a fixed generate() interface. Techniques are discovered via Python entry points declared in a package’s pyproject.toml : on runner initialisation, load_entrypoints scans all installed packages and registers each class under its declared name, making it immediately addressable in configuration files without manual imports or framework modification. The same mechanism applies to metrics and dataset loaders.
paragraphs.zh: 技术。 技术是一种概念消除方法，通过实现固定 generate() 接口的包装器暴露出来。 技术是通过 Python 入口点发现的，这些入口点在包的 pyproject.toml 文件中声明：在运行器初始化时，load_entrypoints 会扫描所有已安装的包，并将每个类按照其声明的名称注册，从而无需手动导入或修改框架即可在配置文件中立即引用。 同样的机制也适用于指标和数据集加载器。

sents.en: Technique.
sents.zh: 技术。

sents.en: A technique is a concept-erasure method exposed through a wrapper implementing a fixed generate() interface.
sents.zh: 技术是一种概念消除方法，通过实现固定 generate() 接口的包装器暴露出来。

sents.en: Techniques are discovered via Python entry points declared in a package’s pyproject.toml : on runner initialisation, load_entrypoints scans all installed packages and registers each class under its declared name, making it immediately addressable in configuration files without manual imports or framework modification.
sents.zh: 技术是通过 Python 入口点发现的，这些入口点在包的 pyproject.toml 文件中声明：在运行器初始化时，load_entrypoints 会扫描所有已安装的包，并将每个类按照其声明的名称注册，从而无需手动导入或修改框架即可在配置文件中立即引用。

sents.en: The same mechanism applies to metrics and dataset loaders.
sents.zh: 同样的机制也适用于指标和数据集加载器。

paragraphs.en: Metric. A metric computes a single evaluation score (e.g., attack success rate, fidelity) over a stream of generated images via an update() method called per batch and a compute() method called at the end of the run.
paragraphs.zh: 指标。 指标通过每批调用一次的 update() 方法和运行结束时调用的 compute() 方法，对生成的图像流计算单个评估分数（例如，攻击成功率、保真度）。

sents.en: Metric.
sents.zh: 指标。

sents.en: A metric computes a single evaluation score (e.g., attack success rate, fidelity) over a stream of generated images via an update() method called per batch and a compute() method called at the end of the run.
sents.zh: 指标通过每批调用一次的 update() 方法和运行结束时调用的 compute() 方法，对生成的图像流计算单个评估分数（例如，攻击成功率、保真度）。

paragraphs.en: Dataset Loader. Dataset loaders supply prompts using one of two strategies. Algorithmically generated prompts are produced on first use and optionally cached to disk to avoid repeating costly optimisation. Fixed benchmark datasets (I2P, COCO, TIFA) are streamed from HuggingFace datasets , ensuring no complete dataset is held in memory.
paragraphs.zh: 数据集加载器。 数据集加载器通过两种策略之一提供提示。 算法生成的提示会在首次使用时创建，并可选择性地缓存到磁盘，以避免重复进行耗时的优化。 固定的基准数据集（I2P、COCO、TIFA）会从 HuggingFace 数据集流式传输，确保没有任何完整的数据集被保留在内存中。

sents.en: Dataset Loader.
sents.zh: 数据集加载器。

sents.en: Dataset loaders supply prompts using one of two strategies.
sents.zh: 数据集加载器通过两种策略之一提供提示。

sents.en: Algorithmically generated prompts are produced on first use and optionally cached to disk to avoid repeating costly optimisation.
sents.zh: 算法生成的提示会在首次使用时创建，并可选择性地缓存到磁盘，以避免重复进行耗时的优化。

sents.en: Fixed benchmark datasets (I2P, COCO, TIFA) are streamed from HuggingFace datasets , ensuring no complete dataset is held in memory.

paragraphs.en: Configuration. Techniques and metrics are paired with frozen dataclass configurations that validate all hyperparameters at initialisation, surfacing misconfigurations before any model weights are loaded. Each experiment writes a concise report (metric scores) and an extended report (scores plus full configuration) to an output directory identified by a unique ID derived from the technique name, metric names, configurations, and timestamp.
paragraphs.zh: 配置。 技术和指标与冻结的数据类配置相结合，这些配置在初始化时验证所有超参数，从而在加载任何模型权重之前发现配置错误。 每次实验都会生成一份简洁的报告（指标分数）和一份扩展报告（分数及完整配置），并将其写入一个输出目录；该目录的名称由一个唯一标识符确定，该标识符源自技术名称、指标名称、配置以及时间戳。

sents.en: Configuration.
sents.zh: 配置。

sents.en: Techniques and metrics are paired with frozen dataclass configurations that validate all hyperparameters at initialisation, surfacing misconfigurations before any model weights are loaded.
sents.zh: 技术和指标与冻结的数据类配置相结合，这些配置在初始化时验证所有超参数，从而在加载任何模型权重之前发现配置错误。

sents.en: Each experiment writes a concise report (metric scores) and an extended report (scores plus full configuration) to an output directory identified by a unique ID derived from the technique name, metric names, configurations, and timestamp.
sents.zh: 每次实验都会生成一份简洁的报告（指标分数）和一份扩展报告（分数及完整配置），并将其写入一个输出目录；该目录的名称由一个唯一标识符确定，该标识符源自技术名称、指标名称、配置以及时间戳。

paragraphs.en: Runner. The runner ties together an unlearning technique, one or more metrics, and their configurations into a single experiment. SingleBenchmarkRunner executes one technique against one metric; MultiBenchmarkRunner evaluates one technique across multiple metrics in a single pass, reusing the loaded model. The run loop streams batches from each metric’s dataset loader, calls technique.generate(prompts) , and accumulates statistics via metric.update() , with final aggregation deferred to metric.compute() . Metric objects are explicitly deleted and garbage-collected between evaluations to reclaim VRAM. Inference runs in FP16, with FP32 used for fine-tuning where numerical stability requires it. Runners are launched via CLI or script, driven by a JSON or YAML configuration file.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体。 该智能体将一种遗忘技术、一个或多个指标及其配置整合到单个实验中。 SingleBenchmarkRunner 针对单个指标执行一种技术；MultiBenchmarkRunner 在一次运行中评估一种技术在多个指标上的表现，并重复使用已加载的模型。 运行循环从每个指标的数据集加载器中流式传输批次，调用 technique.generate(prompts)，并通过 metric.update() 累积统计数据，最终聚合则延迟到 metric.compute()。 在评估之间，Metric 对象会被显式删除并由垃圾回收机制回收，以释放显存。 推理以 FP16 模式运行，而在需要数值稳定性的微调过程中则使用 FP32。 智能体通过命令行接口或脚本启动，由 JSON 或 YAML 配置文件驱动。

sents.en: Runner.
sents.zh: 智能体。

sents.en: The runner ties together an unlearning technique, one or more metrics, and their configurations into a single experiment.
sents.zh: 该智能体将一种遗忘技术、一个或多个指标及其配置整合到单个实验中。

sents.zh: 运行循环从每个指标的数据集加载器中流式传输批次，调用 technique.generate(prompts)，并通过 metric.update() 累积统计数据，最终聚合则延迟到 metric.compute()。

sents.en: Metric objects are explicitly deleted and garbage-collected between evaluations to reclaim VRAM.
sents.zh: 在评估之间，Metric 对象会被显式删除并由垃圾回收机制回收，以释放显存。

sents.en: Inference runs in FP16, with FP32 used for fine-tuning where numerical stability requires it.
sents.zh: 推理以 FP16 模式运行，而在需要数值稳定性的微调过程中则使用 FP32。

sents.en: Runners are launched via CLI or script, driven by a JSON or YAML configuration file.
sents.zh: 智能体通过命令行接口或脚本启动，由 JSON 或 YAML 配置文件驱动。

paragraphs.en: eval-unlearn provides a unified, reproducible benchmarking framework for concept unlearning in T2I diffusion models. By standardizing the evaluation pipeline across twelve techniques and nine metrics, it enables fair cross-method comparison that is otherwise impractical. Its plugin architecture ensures the framework will remain current as the field evolves, and its MIT license minimizes barriers to community adoption and contribution. Future work will support newer Stable Diffusion variants (v2, SDXL), add computational overhead metrics (latency, peak VRAM), expand concept coverage beyond nudity and violence.
paragraphs.zh: eval-unlearn 为 T2I 扩散模型中的概念遗忘提供了一个统一且可复现的基准测试框架。 通过在十二种技术和九项指标上标准化评估流程，它实现了原本难以进行的跨方法公平比较。 其插件架构确保了该框架能随着领域发展保持更新，而 MIT 许可证则最大限度地降低了社区采用和贡献的障碍。 未来的工作将支持更新的 Stable Diffusion 版本（v2、SDXL），增加计算开销指标（延迟、峰值 VRAM），并将概念覆盖范围扩展到裸体和暴力之外的内容。
